links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT responses to patient hip arthroscopy questions (FRES, FKGL)
links.effect: Mean FRES 28.2 (±9.2), college graduate level; mean FKGL 14.4 (±1.8), range 12.1 to 18, college student reading level.
links.quote: The mean FRES was 28.2 (± 9.2 standard deviation), corresponding to a college graduate level, ranging from 11.7 to 42.5.

links.outcome: Accuracy and completeness of ChatGPT answers graded by hip surgeons
links.effect: Consensus grades: A 50% (n=5), B 30% (n=3), C 10% (n=1), D 10% (n=1); incorrect information identified in more than one instance.
links.quote: ChatGPT can answer common patient questions regarding hip arthroscopy with satisfactory accuracy graded by 2 high-volume hip arthroscopists; however, incorrect information was identified in more than one instance.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's accuracy and readability when answering common patient questions about hip arthroscopy without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
